section-85-1.FOR: The responsible body of a school to which this section applies
section-85-1.TO: discriminate against a person— (a) in the arrangements it makes for deciding who is offered admission as a pupil; (b) as to the terms on which it offers to admit the person as a pupil; (c) by not admitting the person as a pupil

section-85-2.FOR: The responsible body of such a school
section-85-2.TO: discriminate against a pupil— (a) in the way it provides education for the pupil; (b) in the way it affords the pupil access to a benefit, facility or service; (c) by not providing education for the pupil; (d) by not affording the pupil access to a benefit, facility or service; (e) by excluding the pupil from the school; (f) by subjecting the pupil to any other detriment

section-85-3.FOR: The responsible body of such a school
section-85-3.TO: harass— (a) a pupil; (b) a person who has applied for admission as a pupil

section-85-4.FOR: The responsible body of such a school
section-85-4.TO: victimise a person— (a) in the arrangements it makes for deciding who is offered admission as a pupil; (b) as to the terms on which it offers to admit the person as a pupil; (c) by not admitting the person as a pupil

section-85-5.FOR: The responsible body of such a school
section-85-5.TO: victimise a pupil— (a) in the way it provides education for the pupil; (b) in the way it affords the pupil access to a benefit, facility or service; (c) by not providing education for the pupil; (d) by not affording the pupil access to a benefit, facility or service; (e) by excluding the pupil from the school; (f) by subjecting the pupil to any other detriment

section-85-6.FOR: the responsible body of such a school

section-91-1.FOR: The responsible body of an institution to which this section applies
section-91-1.TO: discriminate against a person— (a) in the arrangements it makes for deciding who is offered admission as a student; (b) as to the terms on which it offers to admit the person as a student; (c) by not admitting the person as a student

section-91-2.FOR: The responsible body of such an institution
section-91-2.TO: discriminate against a student— (a) in the way it provides education for the student; (b) in the way it affords the student access to a benefit, facility or service; (c) by not providing education for the student; (d) by not affording the student access to a benefit, facility or service; (e) by excluding the student; (f) by subjecting the student to any other detriment

section-91-3.FOR: The responsible body of such an institution
section-91-3.TO: discriminate against a disabled person— (a) in the arrangements it makes for deciding upon whom to confer a qualification; (b) as to the terms on which it is prepared to confer a qualification on the person; (c) by not conferring a qualification on the person; (d) by withdrawing a qualification from the person or varying the terms on which the person holds it

section-91-5.FOR: The responsible body of such an institution
section-91-5.TO: harass— (a) a student; (b) a person who has applied for admission as a student; (c) a disabled person who holds or has applied for a qualification conferred by the institution

section-91-6.FOR: The responsible body of such an institution
section-91-6.TO: victimise a person— (a) in the arrangements it makes for deciding who is offered admission as a student; (b) as to the terms on which it offers to admit the person as a student; (c) by not admitting the person as a student

section-91-7.FOR: The responsible body of such an institution
section-91-7.TO: victimise a student— (a) in the way it provides education for the student; (b) in the way it affords the student access to a benefit, facility or service; (c) by not providing education for the student; (d) by not affording the student access to a benefit, facility or service; (e) by excluding the student; (f) by subjecting the student to any other detriment

section-91-8.FOR: The responsible body of such an institution
section-91-8.TO: victimise a disabled person— (a) in the arrangements it makes for deciding upon whom to confer a qualification; (b) as to the terms on which it is prepared to confer a qualification on the person; (c) by not conferring a qualification on the person; (d) by withdrawing a qualification from the person or varying the terms on which the person holds it

section-91-9.FOR: the responsible body of such an institution

section-92-1.FOR: The responsible body in relation to a course to which this section applies
section-92-1.TO: discriminate against a person— (a) in the arrangements it makes for deciding who is enrolled on the course; (b) as to the terms on which it offers to enrol the person on the course; (c) by not accepting the person's application for enrolment

section-92-2.FOR: The responsible body in relation to such a course
section-92-2.TO: discriminate against a person who is enrolled on the course in the services it provides or offers to provide

section-92-3.FOR: The responsible body in relation to such a course
section-92-3.TO: harass a person who— (a) seeks enrolment on the course; (b) is enrolled on the course; (c) is a user of services provided by the body in relation to the course

section-92-4.FOR: The responsible body in relation to such a course
section-92-4.TO: victimise a person— (a) in the arrangements it makes for deciding who is enrolled on the course; (b) as to the terms on which it offers to enrol the person on the course; (c) by not accepting the person's application for enrolment

section-92-5.FOR: The responsible body in relation to such a course
section-92-5.TO: victimise a person who is enrolled on the course in the services it provides or offers to provide

section-93-1.FOR: The responsible body in relation to facilities to which this section applies
section-93-1.TO: discriminate against a person— (a) in the arrangements it makes for deciding who is provided with the facilities; (b) as to the terms on which it offers to provide the facilities to the person; (c) by not accepting the person's application for provision of the facilities

section-93-2.FOR: The responsible body in relation to such facilities
section-93-2.TO: discriminate against a person who is provided with the facilities in the services it provides or offers to provide

section-93-3.FOR: The responsible body in relation to such facilities
section-93-3.TO: harass a person who— (a) seeks to have the facilities provided; (b) is provided with the facilities; (c) is a user of services provided by the body in relation to the facilities

section-93-4.FOR: The responsible body in relation to such facilities
section-93-4.TO: victimise a person— (a) in the arrangements it makes for deciding who is provided with the facilities; (b) as to the terms on which it offers to provide the facilities to the person; (c) by not accepting the person's application for provision of the facilities

section-93-5.FOR: The responsible body in relation to such facilities
section-93-5.TO: victimise a person who is provided with the facilities in the services it provides or offers to provide

section-96-1.TO: discriminate against a person (B)— (a) in the arrangements A makes for deciding upon whom to confer a relevant qualification; (b) as to the terms on which it is prepared to confer a relevant qualification on B; (c) by not conferring a relevant qualification on B

section-96-2.TO: discriminate against a person (B) upon whom A has conferred a relevant qualification— (a) by withdrawing the qualification from B; (b) by varying the terms on which B holds the qualification; (c) by subjecting B to any other detriment

section-96-3.TO: harass— (a) a person who holds the qualification, or (b) a person who applies for it
section-96-3.IN RELATION TO: conferment by it of a relevant qualification

section-96-4.TO: victimise a person (B)— (a) in the arrangements A makes for deciding upon whom to confer a relevant qualification; (b) as to the terms on which it is prepared to confer a relevant qualification on B; (c) by not conferring a relevant qualification on B

section-96-5.TO: victimise a person (B) upon whom A has conferred a relevant qualification— (a) by withdrawing the qualification from B; (b) by varying the terms on which B holds the qualification; (c) by subjecting B to any other detriment

section-96-8.TO: have regard to— (a) the need to minimise the extent to which disabled persons are disadvantaged in attaining the qualification because of their disabilities; (b) the need to secure that the qualification gives a reliable indication of the knowledge, skills and understanding of a person upon whom it is conferred; (c) the need to maintain public confidence in the qualification

section-96-9.TO: specify any matter for the purposes of subsection (7)
section-96-9.UNLESS: it has consulted such persons as it thinks appropriate

section-96-9.TO: publish matters so specified (including the date from which they are to have effect) in such manner as is prescribed
